claims.text: The local release and selected snapshot place the CoroCoro Comic March 1998 promo source slice on February 15, 1998 as the March 1998 issue insert.
The bounded source slice models two source-pinned card identities: Brock's Onix row 037 and Misty's Staryu row 038, with source_gap_count 0 for this slice.

The two-card pair matters as Gym Leader ownership memory: Brock and Misty are not just species labels, but anime/game character relationships arriving through magazine media before later Gym-set memory can blur the route.

The release matters because it turns a magazine insert into a small relationship object: rock-solid Brock beside water-bright Misty, both Sugimori-clean, both meant to be understood as a pair pulled from CoroCoro rather than as loose Gym-name cards.

narrative.human_title: CoroCoro March 1998 insert — Brock and Misty arrive as a pair
narrative.why_it_matters: This little source slice has a very clean kind of magic. It is not a booster set trying to be complete; it is a CoroCoro reader opening an issue and finding Brock and Misty as a paired object. Brock’s Onix is heavy, stone, gym-leader certainty. Misty’s Staryu is smaller, bright, water-gym motion. Both are Sugimori-clean, which gives the pair an official character-model feeling, but the real identity is the route: February 15, 1998, March issue, two-card insert, rows 037 and 038. The agent has to keep the pair together in memory even when a seller only shows one card.
